LanguageData.RimLumen_EnhanceAdditiveGlow: Enhance vanilla and mod additive glow
LanguageData.RimLumen_EnhanceAdditiveGlowTooltip: Gives fire, explosions and energy shields HDR bloom automatically.\nTurning it off returns to zero-pixel-difference framework mode when no fullscreen shader pack is enabled (the image matches an installation without RimLumen pixel for pixel).
LanguageData.RimLumen_ColorBlendSpaceTooltip: Legacy preserves the existing appearance. Linear makes translucent particles and soft particle edges brighter, and overlaps of opaque particles darker.
LanguageData.RimLumen_DistortionRefractsEffectsToolti: When on, heat haze, shockwaves and other screen distortion also bend the RimLumen particles, ribbons and bloom behind them. When off, only the vanilla scene and light pools bend.
LanguageData.RimLumen_EnableDemoBuildings: Enable demo recreation buildings: firework launcher, particle fountain and lighting comparison street lamps
LanguageData.RimLumen_EnableDemoBuildingsTooltip: Adds five zero-cost demo buildings to the Recreation build menu: a firework launcher, a particle fountain, and three lighting comparison street lamps (visual light only, logical light only, visual plus logical light).

LanguageData.RimLumen_EffectAssetsReloaded: RimLumen effect asset reload: {0} JSON files loaded, {1} failed. Fresh IDs replace same-named assets, including code registrations. Stale scanner-owned keys are released; unrelated code entries, later code overrides of stale keys and already-playing instances are unchanged. Already-loaded XML LumenEffectDef entries are reused, not re-read: edit XML files only with a game restart.
LanguageData.RimLumen_BloomIntensityTooltip: Controls the overall bloom contribution from HDR emitters and particles.
LanguageData.RimLumen_BloomThresholdTooltip: Pixels brighter than this threshold enter the bloom pyramid.
LanguageData.RimLumen_BloomKneeTooltip: Controls the smooth bloom transition around the threshold.
LanguageData.RimLumen_BloomScatterTooltip: Controls the low-frequency glow spread during multilevel upsampling.
LanguageData.RimLumen_StandardPackDescription: RimLumen's built-in default HDR and five-level bloom pipeline. With additive glow enhancement off and no active effects, it preserves a zero-pixel-difference image.
